title: Halloween Ribbon Ideas: Bows, Pumpkins and Autumn Colours
excerpt: Style Halloween with silk ribbon bows, pumpkin decorations and thoughtful gift wrapping in burgundy, espresso brown and champagne gold.
intro:
A burgundy bow around a pale pumpkin. Espresso ribbon against brown paper. A small gold pumpkin pinned to a favourite jacket. A few well-chosen details can give Halloween its own place in your home and wardrobe, while working with the autumn colours you already enjoy.

Silk ribbon brings movement to these arrangements: loose tails can fall over the edge of a basket, frame a place card or soften the shape of a small gift. Start with one project and a limited palette, then carry the same colours through the rest of your setting.

sections.heading: Choose an autumn ribbon palette
sections.body:
Try [Burgundy hand-frayed silk ribbon](https://onesilkribbon.com/collections/hand-frayed-silk-ribbons/burgundy) alongside cream paper, pale pumpkins and dark foliage. Its deeper colour gives a small bow a clear place in the arrangement.

[Espresso Brown](https://onesilkribbon.com/collections/hand-frayed-silk-ribbons/espresso) works with kraft packaging, wooden surfaces and dried stems. Add [Champagne Gold](https://onesilkribbon.com/collections/hand-frayed-silk-ribbons/champagne-gold-hand-frayed-silk-ribbon) where you want a lighter accent.

Lay your ribbon beside the actual materials before making a final choice. Paper, flowers and lighting all affect how a colour looks within a setting.

sections.heading: Tie a ribbon bow around a pumpkin stem
sections.body:
Choose a decorative pumpkin with a firm, accessible stem. Loop the ribbon gently around it and tie a simple bow without pulling hard on the stem.

Adjust the loops first, then let the tails fall along the pumpkin. A shorter bow suits a small place setting; longer tails give a larger pumpkin more movement on a side table. Leave enough ribbon to loosen the knot when the display comes down.

For a group of pumpkins, repeat one ribbon colour across different sizes. Vary the bow proportions to suit each pumpkin.

sections.heading: Add a ribbon detail to the Halloween table
sections.body:
Wrap ribbon around a folded napkin and tuck a place card beneath the knot. Keep the bow small enough to leave room for the name, and position it where guests can easily untie it.

Carry the same ribbon into a small vase of autumn stems or around a basket used for the centrepiece. If your arrangement includes lights, choose battery-operated LED candles and leave the ribbon clear of their fittings.

sections.heading: Wrap a small autumn gift
sections.body:
Brown paper, a handwritten tag and an espresso or burgundy bow make a thoughtful wrapper for a host gift. For Halloween treats, tie the ribbon around a closed paper box or sealed bag, keeping it outside the food packaging.

Make one complete sample before cutting ribbon for several parcels. Measure the piece after tying the bow you want. 

> A LITTLE PLANNING
> 60 cm × 8 parcels = 4.8 m
> Base requirement only. Allow extra for practice pieces and trimming.

Our [ribbon width and length guide](https://onesilkribbon.com/ribbon-guide) offers more help with planning a project.

sections.heading: Wear a small pumpkin detail
sections.body:
The [Gold Silk Pumpkin Brooch with Ribbon Embroidery](https://onesilkribbon.com/collections/handcrafted-adornments/handcrafted-gold-silk-pumpkin-brooch-with-ribbon-embroidery-coquette-cottagecore-floral-pin) gives an autumn outfit a clear seasonal detail. Try it on a lapel or a fabric bag, checking that the material is suitable for a brooch fastening.

For a separate ribbon accent, tie a small bow around a bag handle and keep the tails short enough to stay out of the way. Repeating a colour from your table or gift wrapping can bring the whole celebration together.

sections.heading: Keep the ribbon for your next project
sections.body:
After Halloween, gently untie the bows and put clean, dry ribbon aside for another project. Burgundy, espresso brown and champagne gold can continue into autumn gift wrapping or a seasonal bouquet.

Choose one idea to begin with, make a sample and adjust it to your own setting. Explore our [hand-frayed silk ribbons](https://onesilkribbon.com/collections/hand-frayed-silk-ribbons) to compare the available colours and sizes.
